name: Extended Trilinear Triangulation
aliases: Extended triangulation to the Marching Cubes 33 algorithm
definition: A method to generate a topologically correct, degenerate-free triangulation of the isosurface within a cube by tracking the connectivity of vertices and edges via positive/negative regions defined by the trilinear interpolant, using convex hulls of intersection points.
summary: Extended Trilinear Triangulation generates topologically correct, degenerate-free isosurfaces by extending Marching Cubes 33 with ternary vertex labels and convex hulls to resolve ambiguities and prevent skinny triangles.
